fluff.overview: New technology and creative tactical thinking have long featured in FWLM infantry deployment, with varied unit types and specialized formations treated as the norm rather than the exception. Foot infantry platoons form the garrison backbone of the League's provincial militaries, assigned to hold ground on worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Quality varies with provincial investment, but even modest foot platoons benefit from the FWLM's tradition of equipping infantry with reliable, standardized kit. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of burning gel, these platoons carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry. The short range and danger of carrying volatile fuel make flamer duty one of the most hazardous assignments in the platoon.
